title: GTA VI’s pretentious puzzler makes indie developers feel ‘part of larger culture’
snippet: Tenebrae Lux, a game you can play inside GTA VI. One of the most intriguing games of the year is called Tenebrae Lux. title: Apple’s New AirPods Max, HomePod Mini 2 to Get Product(Red) Release for Holidays
snippet: Apple Inc. is preparing red versions of its entry-level speaker and high-end headphones, reviving a longstanding Product(RED) partnership that raises money to fight AIDS while giving the company fresh colors to sell during the holiday season.

title: Marlowe Hits $1.15B Valuation With Bet Beyond Nvidia
snippet: Marlowe, a startup co-founded by two Microsoft vice presidents, has raised $277 million to pursue ways to boost computing power from chips that rival Nvidia’s processors. The seed round, valuing the company at $1.15 billion, was led by venture firm Accel. Co-founder and CEO Dan Lewis joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Amazon to acquire AI startup Decart's chip software, hire founders
snippet: Decart, founded in 2023, is best known for its software that lets developers sync their AI models across different chips.

title: The Feds Left Iowans in the Dark About Plans to Blow Up Tons of Lead
snippet: The US Army plans to blow up 9,500 pounds of lead azide held at an Iowa ammunition plant. Local officials say they learned most of the details through a press release.
